# Router-name: github_starred  
**Commit time:** 2026.08.11  
**Cookies?:** no  
**Author:** AI转写 / huiinyg-rusting审核 - 来源于RSShub@LanceZhu  
**Introduction:** GitHub 用户收藏的仓库列表  
**Address:** rssust://github_starred  
**Example:** [rssust://github_starred?username=torvalds](/github_starred?username=torvalds)  
**Parameter:**  
1. **username**  
   Type of parameter: string  
   Default value: 无  
   Meaning: GitHub 用户名  
2. **limit**  
   Type of parameter: number  
   Default value: 20  
   Meaning: 条数，最大100
